welcome.title: Welcome to Tacticus Planner
welcome.content: Take a quick tour to discover the key parts of the interface.

accountDrawer.title: Account and preferences
accountDrawer.content: Manage your theme, language, guided tour, imports, planner name, account, and sign-in options here.

addGoal.title: Add Goal
addGoal.content: Create Character or Machine of War goals, then choose one or more projects. The default project is selected automatically.

sync.title: Sync
sync.content: Refresh your Planner with the latest data from Tacticus.

navigation.title: Find your way around
navigation.content: This menu groups the app's sections — use it to navigate between them at any time.

headerControls.title: Theme, language & feedback
headerControls.content: Switch themes, change the language, or send feedback from these icons.

sidebarFooter.title: Your account
sidebarFooter.content: Manage your account and planner name, check sync status, and replay this tour any time from here.

bottomNavigationGroup.title: Your main bar
bottomNavigationGroup.content: Switch sections, add a goal, or sync — all from here.

mobileHeader.title: Page header
mobileHeader.content: Shows where you are. Your account menu — theme, language, and this tour — lives on the right.

character.title: Pick a character
character.content: Choose which character to look up upgrades for.

apply.title: Apply your changes
apply.content: Adjust the rank range or progression, then apply to update the results below.

results.title: Upgrades and farm locations
results.content: See the upgrades needed for this rank range and where to farm them.

share.title: Share this lookup
share.content: Share or copy a link to this exact character and rank range.

createProject.title: Create a project
createProject.content: Start a new project from here without leaving Goals. Your filters and place on the page stay as they are.

statusFilter.title: Filter by status
statusFilter.content: Filter goals by Unfulfilled, Reached, Blocked, Active, or Paused.

filters.title: Type and group
filters.content: Narrow by goal type or group related goals together.

projectFilter.title: Narrow by project
projectFilter.content: Show only the goals in one project. This narrows the list you're looking at and changes nothing about your plan or what Dailies calculates.

createGoal.title: Create a goal
createGoal.content: Start a new goal from here — it opens the same creation dialog as the sidebar button.

planningSettings.title: Planning settings
planningSettings.content: Set your daily energy budget here — every estimate on this page uses it.

reprioritize.title: Prioritize your goals
reprioritize.content: Drag a goal to change its priority (on mobile, tap Reorder first). Each drop saves right away and applies in every project that holds the goal.

list.title: Your goals
list.content: Every goal appears below in your priority order — active and paused goals first, then reached ones. Use a goal's Edit action to change its target, priority, notes, or projects. A character can have several Rank goals, each labelled with its own target.

acquisitionSources.title: Acquisition sources
acquisitionSources.content: Combine campaign farming, Onslaught, and daily shops — select any mix to lower this goal's estimated time.

projects.title: Projects
projects.content: Search for a project name that doesn't exist yet and choose Create to add it here without leaving this form. Which projects hold the goal never changes its status or priority.

list.title: What a project is
list.content: A project is a named selection of your goals — keep several to group different things. The Default project is listed first; a project does not pause or resume anything or change your priorities.

newProject.title: Create a project
newProject.content: Start a new project here, or use a project's action menu to rename, describe, recolor, archive, or restore it.

header.title: A selection of your goals
header.content: This project holds a selection of your account's goals — the summary shows how many of them are here. Its progress metrics, project switcher, and actions all live in this header.

addGoals.title: Choose what's in the project
addGoals.content: Add or remove several goals at once — search your goals (listed in your priority order), group them by unit or type, tick the ones that belong here, review the summary, and save in a single step. Saving never changes your priority order. A unit can have several Rank targets here, but an exact duplicate target is blocked.

createGoal.title: Create a new goal
createGoal.content: Start a brand-new goal already set to this project. Unlike Add goals, which puts existing goals in, this makes a new one — you can still change its project before saving.

reprioritize.title: Prioritize your goals
reprioritize.content: Drag any goal to change its priority. Moving a goal here also moves it in your priority order; goals from other projects keep their relative order. On mobile, tap Reorder first to enter reorder mode.

selector.title: Choose a project
selector.content: Switch to a different project's own view — separate from managing projects on the list.

goals.title: Project goals
goals.content: This project's goals appear here, grouped by goal type to start. Each Rank target is its own goal, labelled with its target, and can be reordered, paused, or deleted on its own. Use Group to switch to one block per unit, or to turn grouping off for a flat list.

rowActions.title: Remove without deleting
rowActions.content: Each goal's menu can take it out of this project alone. Deleting, further down the same menu, removes it from your whole account.

target.title: Target
target.content: Change where this goal ends without recreating it. It keeps its history, and your plan recalculates when you save.

priority.title: Priority
priority.content: Pick this goal's position in your priority order. It moves there when you save, and the goals in between shift by one place.

projects.title: Projects
projects.content: Add this goal to a project, or create a new one from the picker. The new project is saved right away; the goal itself only changes when you save.
